Epic's launcher-log parser (Riot has its own parseLogEvents). arg0 is the log text as eventsSince (src/main/launchers/epic/launcher-log.ts) gets it: readLogSince, readTail, readRange, buf.toString utf8, so a BOM is kept and invalid bytes become U+FFFD. readTail drops a clipped first line before the text gets here.
Lines split on /\r?\n/; a line longer than MAX_LOG_LINE_LENGTH (16384) UTF-16 code units is skipped whole (the cap-line cases). The checks run in this order per line: AutoSignIn, SignIn, OnLoginComplete (TRUE or FALSE), AllCheckComplete, Restarting with EpicGamesUpdater.exe, Engine exit requested or a line starting "Log file closed".
A signed-in accountId is lower-cased when it is 32 hex digits and empty otherwise; at is the line's [yyyy.mm.dd-hh.mm.ss:mmm] prefix as an ISO string, not checked as a date. A failure reason drops "errormessage=", everything from "errorpath=", every 32-hex run (as …) and outer whitespace.
No byte cap in the function: it relies on readLogSince (MAX_TAIL_BYTES, 8 MiB).
